query:
SELECT d.id as "document_id!", d.name as "name!"
            FROM "Document" d
            JOIN document_sub_type dt ON dt.document_id = d.id AND dt.sub_type = 'skill'
            WHERE d.owner = $1 AND d."deletedAt" IS NULL AND d.name ILIKE $2
            ORDER BY d."updatedAt" DESC
            LIMIT 20
